<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at main -->

## What's Changed
* Verify API formula patch downloads by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24285
* Require verifiable official formula sources by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24287
* Honour explicit cask checksum requirements by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24288
* livecheck: prefer `Git` livecheck over `GithubLatest` by @bevanjkay in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24280
* Keep outdated `:no_linkage` build dependencies by @HaraldNordgren in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24290
* cask/audit: skip livecheck requirement for :latest by @bevanjkay in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24297
* advisory-match: exclude reviewed false aliases by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24296
* Extract tarballs with a UTF-8 locale by @IngmarStein in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24304
* Combine dependency role tags from API metadata by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24302
* Match newlines in tap path regex by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24303
* Warn when the upstream remote isn't `origin` by @HaraldNordgren in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24299
* Treat archive filenames literally by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24305
* Keep patches in stable blocks during bumps by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24307
* cask/audit: reject new casks requiring Rosetta by @bevanjkay in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24309
* generate-cask-ci-matrix: skip signing on macOS 15 by @bevanjkay in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24312
* Fix ZIP volume label specs on macOS 27 by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24313
* Don't flag newer CLT releases as outdated by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24314
* info: remove stale `installed_as_dependency` TODO by @hyuraku in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24318
* bundle cleanup: report failed removals by @edel67 in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24289
* Require `zap` stanzas in new casks by @bevanjkay in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24315
* Prefill `app` and `zap` in `brew create --cask` by @bevanjkay in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24316
* Skip unavailable MacPorts website links by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24326
* Sign temporary keg copies before restoring them by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24325
* Bump portable-ruby to 4.0.8 by @brew-commit-app[bot] in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24323
* Warn about Git sandbox configuration failures by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24329
* formula: deuniversalize the keg being installed by @zbeekman in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24327
* Bump portable-ruby to 4.0.9 by @brew-commit-app[bot] in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24334
* Honour curl environment options consistently by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24328
* dmg: skip legacy desktop metadata by @QuillVot in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24331
* Re-read terminal size on resize during downloads by @mxtymoshyk in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24338
* Allow Keychain tokens for Git downloads by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24341
* Restart systemd services on unsuccessful exit by @xucian in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24342
* cask/audit: strip gktool progress from errors by @bevanjkay in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24344
* list: fail clearly for uninstalled casks when piped by @aktanazat in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24345
* Speed up linking and unlinking kegs by @krehel in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24332
* keg_relocate: strip high bytes before matched paths by @andrew in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24321
* Preserve UTF-8 paths in ELF loader strings by @andrew in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24349
* Prefer reliable installed download tools by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24346
* Share analytics queries and package downloads by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24350
* Allow reading private sandbox temporary files by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24351
* Limit implicit item trust to install commands by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24352
* download_queue: name the download in checksum mismatch errors by @Moisan in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24353
* Document Homebrew and MDM administration by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24355

## New Contributors
* @QuillVot made their first contribution in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24331
* @mxtymoshyk made their first contribution in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24338
* @xucian made their first contribution in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24342
* @aktanazat made their first contribution in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24345

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/compare/7.0.10...7.0.11
